name: two muons (random charges)
description: Two muons per event from a single vertex, each charge drawn independently from {mu-, mu+} (mu-mu- / mu-mu+ / mu+mu+ at 25/50/25%). Each muon has its own kinetic energy, uniform in [200, 2000] MeV, and its own isotropic direction. Bomb source with min_particles = max_particles = 2, sampling with replacement.
